retired.gpt-astra: GPT-6 Astra, replaced completely by GPT-6.1 Sol (seat gpt-6.1-sol).
retired.claude-fable: Claude Fable 5.1, replaced completely by Claude Opus 5.5 (seat claude-opus-5.5).

selectionRule: A pair is always two different models (never the same model identity). Automatic picks rank usable seats by tier (CTO first), then a different vendor from the partner seat, then a different family, then this preferenceOrder. Two CTOs from different vendors are standard grade; two CTOs from one vendor are lower grade (single vendor); any seat below CTO makes the pair lower grade (below CTO level); one seat alone is a single reviewer, never a consensus. GPT-6.2 Sol is the primary GPT seat, GPT-6.1 Sol its tier 1 reserve, and Opus 5.5 the primary Claude seat.

gpt-6.2-sol.label: GPT-6.2 Sol at xhigh
gpt-6.2-sol.note: Primary GPT seat (CTO at xhigh or above, Tech lead at high).

gpt-6.1-sol.label: GPT-6.1 Sol at xhigh
gpt-6.1-sol.note: Reserve: the GPT co-CTO where Codex does not offer GPT-6.2 Sol.

grok-4.7.label: Grok 4.7 at xhigh
grok-4.7.note: Backup seat: trusted as a CTO at its highest offered setting (xhigh; no max is offered). Runs in a disposable copy of the project.

claude-opus-5.5.label: Claude Opus 5.5 at xhigh
claude-opus-5.5.note: First-choice Claude seat. Claude Opus 5.5 is a CTO at high effort or above; the seat runs at xhigh, with high also allowed.

claude-opus.label: Claude Opus 5 at xhigh
claude-opus.note: Reserve Claude seat: drafts and reviews where Claude Code is older than 2.1.280 and pairs with Opus 5.5 on Claude-only machines. Runs at xhigh.

gpt-6-sol.label: GPT-6 Sol at xhigh
gpt-6-sol.note: Fallback seat below CTO level (Tech lead). Picked only when no CTO-level partner is usable; the task is then labelled lower grade.

claude-sonnet-5.label: Claude Sonnet 5 at xhigh
claude-sonnet-5.note: Fallback seat below CTO level (Tech lead at xhigh). Picked only when no CTO-level partner is usable; the task is then labelled lower grade.

grok-4.6.label: Grok 4.6 at xhigh
grok-4.6.note: Fallback seat below CTO level (Tech lead), for Cursor plans without Grok 4.7. Runs in a disposable copy of the project, like grok-4.7.

gpt-5.6-sol.label: GPT-5.6 Sol at xhigh
gpt-5.6-sol.note: Fallback seat below CTO level (Tech lead), for Codex versions or plans without GPT-6.

gpt-6-luna.label: GPT-6 Luna at high
gpt-6-luna.note: Task-sizing assessor (trial): the cheapest model the rules allow to make a judgement call (Developer tier). Never a consensus seat.

claude-sonnet-5.5.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5 at high
claude-sonnet-5.5.note: Assessor fallback where Codex is missing: Sonnet 5.5 at high effort requires Claude Code 2.1.284 or later. Never a consensus seat.

claude-sonnet-4.6.label: Claude Sonnet 4.6 at high
